## Angular ScrollView Component

The [Kendo UI for Angular ScrollView](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview) component represents a horizontal collection of content or image views with built-in navigation tools, automatic scrolling and visual indicators to help users keep track of their location in the collection at any time.

## Key Features

Among the many features which the Kendo UI for Angular ScrollView delivers are:

* [Animations](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/animations)&mdash;The ScrollView allows you to enable or disable its built-in animations, which are enabled by default.
* [Arrows](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/arrows)&mdash;Allows controlling the behavior of the built-in navigation arrows of the ScrollView, which are disabled by default.
* [Paging](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/paging)&mdash;Provides options for enabling or disabling its built-in paging functionality as well as for adding a pager overlay.
* [Endless Scrolling](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/endless-scrolling)&mdash;You can enable the endless scrolling mode which loops through its views in an endless fashion and is disabled by default. 
* [Dimensions](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/dimensions)&mdash;Enables customizing the dimensions of the ScrollView by defining its width and height.
* [Data Sources](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/data-sources)&mdash;You can set a data source for the ScrollView to provide it with data.
* [Active Items](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/active-items)&mdash;Allows rendering an active item in the ScrollView by using the available configuration of the component.
* [Globalization](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/globalization)&mdash;By using the available globalization options in Kendo UI for Angular, you can translate the ScrollView messages by adapting them to specific culture locales. Additionally, the ScrollView supports rendering in a right-to-left (RTL) direction.
* [Accessibility](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/accessibility)&mdash;The ScrollView is accessible for screen readers and supports WAI-ARIA attributes.
* [Keyboard Navigation](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/scrollview/keyboard-navigation)&mdash;The ScrollView supports a number of keyboard shortcuts which allow users to accomplish various commands.
